preconditions.description: The number of abbreviations to process is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each abbreviation contains at most nine digits.
preconditions.description: Each abbreviation is a string of the form 'IAO'' followed by one to nine digits.

postconditions.expression: For each abbreviation, the output is the year of the corresponding Olympiad.
postconditions.description: The output for each abbreviation is the year that corresponds to the abbreviation, calculated by appending the digits to the year 1989 and ensuring the result is greater than or equal to 1989.
